note: Time budgets were first set from an Apple M-series laptop (node 22, theme ../lateen, 3 runs, median) with a margin of 2x, then raised on 2026-11-17 to what the ubuntu-latest CI runner measures, so a healthy build on a slower runner passes. Memory keeps its 2x margin. A budget goes down when a change makes the build faster; raising one needs a note in the pull request.
